text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the cafeteria for lunch,
when...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, tell me! I'll keep it a secret,
promise!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As I said, you're asking the wrong
person...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey there. Nothing much, Mayano
here is just
spouting nonsense...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Am not! I'm telling you, Nature, you've
been sooo
twinkly lately!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The way you run is so zoom-zoooom!
And you're
always smiling! Something
must've happened to
you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
First of all, I'm not "twinkly" at all. My
trainer's
just got a silver tongue...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You see, my trainer is so good that I
can't help
feeling motivated, even if I
don't want to!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Is that reeeally it? What else
would make
a girl all twinkly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Oh, I think I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oooh my gosh! I'm getting butterflies in
my stomach! ☆ I can't just sit here
watching you two
being so cute
together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do you mean, "being cute"?!
You don't
seriously think—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Mayano! I'm pretty sure you
have the
wrong idea! Waaait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite understand what just
happened, but it seems like my guidance
is having a positive
effect on Nice
Nature!
